name: Domain-Locker
description: Keep track of every domain name you own, with expiry alerts and monitoring

paths.name: Data
paths.description: The SQLite database (domain-locker.db) with your domains, their history, uptime checks and notifications. Back this folder up.

ports.name: Web UI
ports.description: Domain Locker web app and API, published on host as 6180

variables.name: TZ
variables.description: Your time zone, like Europe/London or America/New_York.

variables.name: DL_ENV_TYPE
variables.description: Keep it as selfHosted. It turns on the built-in SQLite database and the built-in scheduler.

variables.name: DL_AUTH_PASSWORD
variables.description: Optional but recommended. A password people must type to open Domain Locker. Leave it empty and anyone who can reach the app can see and change your domains.
